messages.content: Hi Emma, thanks for requesting a demo! I'm Alex from the sales team. What sparked your interest in our platform?
Hi Alex! We're a young startup and we saw your product featured in TechCrunch. It looks like exactly what we need for customer engagement.
That's great to hear! Tell me a bit about StartupXYZ. What do you do and how big is your team?
We're building an AI-powered fitness app. Right now we're a team of 12 - 8 engineers, 2 designers, and 2 of us handling business operations.
Sounds exciting! What's your current approach to customer engagement and support?
Honestly, it's a mess. We're using email, a basic chatbot, and sometimes just responding on social media. We need something more unified.
I hear you. That fragmented approach is really common for growing startups. Are you the decision-maker for tooling purchases?
Yes, I'm the CEO and co-founder, so I make those calls. My co-founder handles the tech side but he trusts my judgment on operational tools.
Perfect. And do you have a budget in mind for customer engagement tooling?
We're bootstrapped right now, so budget is tight. Ideally under $500/month to start, but we just closed a seed round so we could scale up if needed.
Congratulations on the funding! We actually have a startup program that might be perfect for you - 50% off for the first year.
Oh that's amazing! That would definitely work for us. Can we set up a proper demo this week?
Absolutely! How does Thursday at 2pm work for you?
Perfect, I'll have my co-founder join as well. Looking forward to it!
